camel_example: aliyun cloud-siem BindAccount --region cn-hangzhou --CloudCode hcloud --AccountId 123xxxxxxx --AccessId ABCXXXXXXXX --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AccountName xxxx
description_en: Binds a multicloud account from Multicloud Assets of Security Center to Threat Analysis
description_zh: 绑定云安全中心功能设置-多云资产中设置的多云账号到威胁分析
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem bind-account --access-id ABCXXXXXXXX --account-name xxxx --account-id 123xxxxxxx --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BindAccount

parameters.help_en: The AccessKey ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: access_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the multicloud account
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:

aliyun: Alibaba Cloud
hcloud: Huawei Cloud
qcloud: Tencent Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
aliyun：阿里云
hcloud：华为云
qcloud：腾讯云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the data management center of Threat Analysis is located. You must select a region for the data management center based on the region where your assets reside. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are deployed in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: Your assets are deployed in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member to whose view the administrator switches
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The type of the view.

0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

Data.description_en: The detailed information returned by the Threat Analysis service
Data.description_zh: 威胁分析服务返回的具体内容

Count.description_en: The number of account bindings that are added
Count.title_zh: 添加账号绑定的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败。
